使用当前预设草稿生成提示词，不生成图片，也不保存修改。: Preview prompts from the current draft without generating images or saving changes.
保存当前预设，包括固定词、输出顺序和共现扩展设置。: Save this preset, including fixed terms, output order and co-occurrence settings.
删除预设“{0}”？此操作无法撤销。: Delete preset “{0}”? This cannot be undone.
匹配词库，作为共现扩展的正向锚点。: Found in the library. Used as a positive anchor for co-occurrence expansion.
匹配词库，输出为负向提示词，不参与共现筛选。: Found in the library. Included in the negative prompt and excluded from co-occurrence filtering.
固定提示词不能为空，请填写或移除空项。: Fixed terms cannot be empty. Enter text or remove empty items.
固定正向词数量超过标签上限。: The number of fixed positive terms exceeds the tag limit.
图片评级标签，可添加为固定正向词以参与共现筛选。: Image rating tag. Add it as a fixed positive term to use it in co-occurrence filtering.
在上下限之间等概率抽取目标数量；无法达到时返回已生成的内容。: Choose a target count uniformly between the limits. If it cannot be reached, return the terms generated so far.
展开{0}匹配项；点击或用方向键选择后回车添加: Show matches for {0}. Click to add, or select with the arrow keys and press Enter.
当前预设有未保存的修改，继续会放弃这些修改。: This preset has unsaved changes. Continuing will discard them.
所有模式共用的搜索步数上限。达到上限时返回已生成的提示词。: Search step limit for all modes. Return the prompts generated so far when the limit is reached.
拖动调整{0}第 {1} 项的输出顺序，也可按 ↑/↓ 排序: Drag to reorder item {1} in {0}, or use ↑/↓.
数据集中包含此标签的图片数量: Number of images containing this tag in the dataset
数量包含固定正向词。固定词超过下限时，以固定词数作为有效下限。: Includes fixed positive terms. If their count exceeds the minimum, their count becomes the effective minimum.
新标签与每个已有可统计正向标签的 PMI 都须达到此值。0 为独立预期，正数更常: The PMI between a new tag and every existing positive tag with statistics must meet this threshold. Zero indicates independence; positive values mean more frequent co-occurrence, negative values less.
无合法变化，保持上一帧: No valid changes; previous frame retained
未匹配词库，保留完整文本输出，不参与共现筛选。: Not found in the library. The full text is retained in the output and excluded from co-occurrence filtering.
标签数量下限不能大于上限。: The minimum tag count cannot exceed the maximum.
标签数量下限须为至少 1 的整数。: The minimum tag count must be an integer of at least 1.
根据标签共同出现的情况扩展正向提示词。统计相关不保证画面协调。: Expand positive prompts using tag co-occurrence statistics. Statistical correlation does not guarantee visual coherence.
每对标签须共同出现至少此次数。词库只保留共现 ≥10 次的关系，降低门槛不会恢复: Each tag pair must occur together at least this many times. Only pairs with 10 or more co-occurrences are retained; lowering the threshold does not restore removed pairs.
每次生成均保留这些词，按列表顺序输出。: Keep these terms in every generation, in the order shown.
每行一个关键词，例如：\nhair\nblack socks:
One keyword per line, for example:
hair
black socks
每行一个关键词；忽略大小写，空格与下划线等价。: One keyword per line. Case is ignored; spaces and underscores are equivalent.
词库只读：普通标签保留出现至少 100 次的项，另含四个图片评级标签。: The library is read only. General tags occurring at least 100 times are retained, along with four image rating tags.
词库尚无标签，请先导入数据。: The library has no tags yet. Import data first.
词库暂不可用，仍可输入提示词并回车添加: The library is unavailable. You can still enter a prompt and press Enter to add it.
词库识别暂不可用，尚未确定来源；编辑词项可重试: Library lookup is unavailable, so the source is unknown. Edit the term to retry.
跳过包含关键词的新抽取标签。固定正负词与停泊保持的提示词不重新过滤。: Skip newly sampled tags containing these keywords. Fixed positive and negative terms and prompts held in Anchor mode are not filtered again.
输入完整提示词后识别来源: Enter a complete prompt to identify its source
输入完整提示词并回车添加: Enter a complete prompt and press Enter to add it
输入完整提示词并回车添加，也可选择词库匹配项。: Enter a complete prompt and press Enter to add it, or choose a matching library tag.
输入提示词，回车添加: Enter a prompt, press Enter to add
限制连续序列和顺流漫游每帧的标签增删数，替换计 2 次。固定词保留；无合法变化时: Limit tag additions and removals per frame in sequences and Flow mode. A replacement counts as 2 changes. Fixed terms are retained. Keep the previous frame if no valid change is possible; a budget of 0 keeps all terms.
预览当前预设，不生成图片。: Preview this preset without generating images.
直接用于生图，不参与共现扩展。: Used directly for image generation; not part of co-occurrence expansion.
用于生图；共现扩展跳过同名词，不参与 PMI 计算。: Used for image generation. Co-occurrence expansion skips matching terms; negatives do not take part in PMI calculations.
匹配词库，输出为负向提示词；共现扩展跳过同名词。: Matched in the library and used as a negative prompt. Co-occurrence expansion skips the same term.
未匹配词库，保留完整文本输出，不参与 PMI 比较。: Not found in the library. Keep the full text in the output without PMI comparisons.
